largestWeight.requirement: Largest holding as a share of equity.

exposure.requirement: Invested value as a share of equity.

hhi.requirement: Herfindahl index of invested weights; needs at least one holding.

effectiveHoldings.requirement: 1 / HHI; needs at least one holding.

profit.requirement: Equity minus net contributions, in DT. Profit is an amount, not a rate of return.

timeWeightedReturn.requirement: Chains returns between deposits and withdrawals, so flows do not count as performance. Since creation, not annualised.

moneyWeightedReturn.requirement: Modified Dietz: gain divided by time-weighted capital, so the timing of your deposits matters. Since creation, not annualised.

valueAtRisk95.requirement: No holdings: cash carries no price risk in this simulation.

expectedShortfall95.requirement: No holdings: cash carries no price risk in this simulation.

realizedVolatilityAnnualized.requirement: Daily volatility × √365 (the simulated market trades every day). At least 5 complete days of portfolio history since creation.

maxDrawdown.requirement: Largest peak-to-trough fall of the time-weighted value index (deposits and withdrawals removed).
